## In this file

- Register 3 dependency providers before startup.
- Run 2 other startup steps in source order.

## Dependency providers

Register these providers before startup. Their declaration order does not set initialization order; shared instances initialize in dependency order.

- Provide [`SystemConsole`](.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/io/contracts.aug.md#symbol-SystemConsole) when `Console` is requested. Reuse one instance.
- Provide [`NumberRepository`](types.aug.md#symbol-NumberRepository) when `Repository<int>` is requested. Reuse one instance.
- Provide [`Program`](types.aug.md#symbol-Program) when `app` is requested. Reuse one instance. Required dependencies: `Repository<int>`.

## Startup, in source order

- Set `program` to the instance provided for `app`.
- Call [`Program.start`](types.aug.md#symbol-Program.start) on `program`; inject `console` from `Console`.
